name: Nur
source:
She’s in her late twenties, an immigrant from a Mediterranean Muslim country currently going through a civil war. She has suffered a lot in the latest years, so she has turned bitter and distrustful, detaches herself from people. She rarely smiles. She has just recently legalized her status in the country, but she speaks the language poorly and works as a prostitute until she can get a better job.

[From Casting Call]
